feature: Recent lists the documents you open
summary: The front door's Recent now shows the documents you saved or opened, with a picture of each, among your newest captures, and File has Open Recent with Clear Menu. Opening a document that is already open brings its window forward instead of opening a second copy.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default.

try.do: Open any picture, press Shift Command S and save it as a project.
Close its window, then press Shift Command N.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Click the project's card under Recent: it opens in its own window and the front door closes.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Open File > Open Recent and pick the same project: the window you already have comes forward.
Point at a document card on a new front door, or right click it: Edit, Show in Finder, Remove from Recent.
Pick File > Open Recent > Clear Menu, open another New Window: Recent shows captures only.

evaluate: Does mixing documents and captures in one Recent row, newest first, read as one list, or would you rather documents came first?
Is a document's saved picture (the whole canvas, shrunk) enough to recognise it at card size?
Should opening a capture from Recent or history also move it to the front of Recent, or only documents you open by file?
Does Remove from Recent, rather than Delete, feel right on a document card?
rough: A document card's hover row is Edit, Show in Finder and Remove from Recent, not the mock's Copy, Edit, Pin and Delete: Pin exists nowhere in the app and Delete would throw away your own file; the question is filed as a-recent-document-card-offers-the-mock-s-copy-pi.
Captures keep the history strip's own row (Copy, Edit, Show in Finder, Delete) as the front door shipped it, also covered by a-recent-document-card-offers-the-mock-s-copy-pi.
A project saved before today has no picture inside it, so its card shows a plain document glyph until it is saved again.
A saved video's picture is drawn from the frame under the playhead when it was saved; no walk has looked at one yet, so it may miss the recording's own frames.
